stops.stop: Careggi, the death
stops.date_confidence: Attested, 1 August 1464. The joint disease was called gout by contemporaries; a modern skeletal re-reading of the Medici tombs proposes diffuse idiopathic skeletal hyperostosis instead, but the exhumed series is the grand-ducal Medici of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, not Cosimo the Elder, whose remains lie undisturbed in the San Lorenzo crypt. For him the reading rests on the deformed hands in Pontormo's posthumous portrait, not on bone.
